ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the primary surface area with localized high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters at the lateral distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation field with one distinct, high-contrast circular blob on the upper-mid region of the right lobe and several fine-line high-contrast pixel disruptions on the lower-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; interior angle approximately 55 degrees with a defined vertex partially obscured at the base by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by alternating sharp peaks and shallow U-shaped valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary from the median notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to both lobes, extending from the central notch to the lateral tips with a consistent outward arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, roughly circular and cylindrical pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer corners of both lobes; singular circular high-contrast spot on the upper-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, light-colored linear pixel paths (rake marks) oriented horizontally and diagonally on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) concentrated on the lateral tips of the fluke lobes; multiple fine-line scratches on the ventral surface.
